custom_expected:

  • The tooltip does not start at the browser window's left edge.
  • The tooltip's dark box is no wider than 326 pixels (less than a quarter of the 1440-pixel window).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12307 (Story 5, Locked Bill To: invoiced and deposits)

  • S5-R1: “When Invoiced, the Bill To field is read-only with M4 as its tooltip.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794510417-a68d (its boards and design library are byte-identical to version 1794239066-4906 read 9 Nov 2026), read 13 Nov 2026: design library file ds/shopview/components.css, section TOOLTIP (spec components/Tooltip/preview.html).

The design's own words:

  • “The placement class and the arrow class are INVERSES: a tooltip above the trigger carries an arrow on its bottom edge.”
  • “max-width: 326px;”
  • “.sv-tt-pop--top { bottom: calc(100% + 10px); left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(4px); }”
  • “.sv-tt-pop--bottom { top: calc(100% + 10px); left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-4px); }”
  • “.sv-tt-pop--right { left: calc(100% + 10px); top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%) translateX(-4px); }”
  • “.sv-tt-pop--left { right: calc(100% + 10px); top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%) translateX(4px); }”

The design library's tooltip rule decides where the tooltip sits. The "Hover" pictures on page "3 When the Bill To is blocked" draw it at the window's left edge, which breaks that rule, so this case follows the library (BT-D08; PO question 11 withdrawn 12 Nov 2026). The two pictures still attached to this case (bt-p3-03-after-hover.png, bt-p3-07-after-hover.png) show that old place: ignore them for this check.
